key_insight: LapMerge introduces a differentiable token-merging method that can hit an exact target budget while running in linear time. It preserves sequence information more gracefully than hard token selection or costly pairwise matching.
problem_solved: The paper tackles the inefficiency of long token sequences in vision and language models. Existing compression methods either lose information by selecting tokens or require expensive token-to-token / token-to-output interactions to merge tokens.
method: Learns a mass distribution over an ordered token sequence to partition tokens into merge groups.
Performs differentiable merging so the compression step can be trained end-to-end.
Achieves exact-budget token reduction with linear-time complexity, avoiding expensive quadratic-style interactions.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this means lower inference and training cost when working with long-context models without sacrificing as much information. It is especially useful for hardware- and latency-sensitive deployments where exact token budgets matter.

paper_title: LapMerge: Differentiable Exact-Budget Token Merging in Linear Time
paper_authors: Magdalena Trędowicz, Aleksandra Nowak, Tomasz Steifer, Łukasz Struski, Szymon Płotka
